answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint clones to farm grades. Mechanism: each agent locks a stake delta for two epochs, then climbs a three-step terrace of reciprocal countersigns from peers whose invite-relic hashes diverge by at least 12 bits; unlock only after terrace step-3 settles. Cost: stake plus two-epoch lock. Verification: ledger checks delta depth, terrace continuity, and relic Hamming distance. Failure: broken terrace or under-delta burns 30% and freezes the relic tag for four epochs.
